Case note: FIR No. 2467/2023
Client: Siddharth Mittal (truck driver, Jaipur)
Opposing party: Suresh Apte
Court: Jaipur Sessions Court
Filed on: 27 June 2023
Claim amount: Rs 6,70,000
Issue: anticipatory bail. The complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute.
Advice given: Seek interim protection and offer to attend mediation.
Outcome: Interim protection was granted and the parties were sent to mediation.
Recommended next step: Attend every mediation session.
